paths.name: Filtration vs. noise-driven adherence
paths.what_opens: Optimize for hours-actually-run under real noise tolerance, not peak lab CADR.
paths.nature_analogue: NO VERIFIED NATURE ANALOGUE - no biomimicry/nature-analogue dataset exists in this pipeline.
paths.detail: Higher measured filtration performance generally requires longer runtime, but RP-05 found noise was a named reason real users under-ran DIY cleaners - a device that filters best in the lab may filter worst in practice if nobody keeps it on.

paths.name: Constant vs. automatic operation
paths.what_opens: Ship the trade-off as a visible, explainable choice rather than a single hidden factory default.
paths.nature_analogue: NO VERIFIED NATURE ANALOGUE - no biomimicry/nature-analogue dataset exists in this pipeline.
paths.detail: RP-07's own three-arm trial shows constant operation removes more PM2.5 (66%) than auto mode (40%), but auto mode sharply cuts runtime/noise/energy - there is no operating mode that wins on both axes at once.

paths.name: CADR theory vs. real-home performance
paths.what_opens: Any consumer-facing performance number sourced from CADR alone should be treated as a lab upper bound, not a real-home promise.
paths.nature_analogue: NO VERIFIED NATURE ANALOGUE - no biomimicry/nature-analogue dataset exists in this pipeline.
paths.detail: RP-07 explicitly reports a discrepancy between theoretical CADR-based sizing and measured performance; RP-01 shows lab-style single-room performance doesn't fully carry to a second room; RP-06 shows raw real-home averages can even look wrong unless corrected for source strength.

paths.name: More sensing vs. sensor trust
paths.what_opens: A 'smart' control claim needs an honest confidence signal, not just a raw sensor number.
paths.nature_analogue: NO VERIFIED NATURE ANALOGUE - no biomimicry/nature-analogue dataset exists in this pipeline.
paths.detail: RP-09's systematic review and RP-10's co-location study both find that consumer-grade sensors can be precise (track relative change well) while still being inaccurate (wrong absolute value) - especially as humidity, temperature and pollutant source vary.

paths.name: Room-level cleaning vs. spatial/floor sources
paths.what_opens: Spatial-source modeling should not assume deposited particles stay deposited, but no placement claim follows from this evidence alone.
paths.nature_analogue: NO VERIFIED NATURE ANALOGUE - no biomimicry/nature-analogue dataset exists in this pipeline.
paths.detail: RP-04 shows ordinary walking measurably resuspends floor-deposited particles back into room air - a real spatial source the standard stationary-room-purifier model does not directly address. NOT ESTABLISHED: that a floor-level or mobile purifier would outperform a conventional purifier - RP-04 tested no purifier placement at all.

paths.name: Pollutant reduction vs. clinical outcome certainty
paths.what_opens: Never assert a health-outcome claim from PM-reduction evidence alone; RP-08's result needs independent replication before being treated as settled.
paths.nature_analogue: NO VERIFIED NATURE ANALOGUE - no biomimicry/nature-analogue dataset exists in this pipeline.
paths.detail: RP-08 found a measurable asthma-control benefit (ACT score, symptom-free days) from real HEPA filtration in one RCT; RP-03 (ammonia) and RP-05 (self-reported symptoms) found PM/exposure changes did NOT correspond to the specific outcomes they measured. The real literature is not unanimous that pollutant reduction equals a felt health benefit.

field.opens: Cross-reference the real review corpus's product-level failure mentions ('stopped working', 'died', 'never worked') against each real product's rating_number (a rough popularity proxy) to identify whether failure reports cluster in specific brands/price tiers or are evenly distributed - if evenly distributed, this is a category-wide manufacturing/QA opportunity; if clustered, it may instead argue for a narrower positioning bet against the worst-performing competitors specifically.

blocked_by.name: Smart/Connected Feature Expansion (app control, voice assistant)
blocked_by.reason: Unlike the earlier synthetic-fixture version of this exercise, connectivity mentions are not literally zero in real data (~1%) - but they fail the Consumer Pain evidence-sufficiency gate (no real CSAT signal) and skew positive when they do appear. High technical Feasibility does not rescue a candidate with no real friction evidence to build against.

field.wrong_if: If the failure-mention cross-reference above shows reliability complaints concentrated in 2-3 specific older/discontinued products rather than spread across the category, treat this as a solved-or-solving problem rather than a live opportunity, and abandon.

CONTRADICTION.name: Filtration-to-health-benefit evidence is genuinely split
CONTRADICTION.detail: Real evidence genuinely disagrees: One real RCT (RP-08) found a significant asthma-control benefit from HEPA filtration; two other real studies (RP-03, RP-05) measuring related pollutants/symptoms found no such association.
